summary: Tested Tasks Module (Departments, Projects, Tasks, Documents) - All 24 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - departments grid, projects view with filters, project detail with tasks and documents, all CRUD modals working correctly. Fixed timezone bug in timer stop functionality.
seed_data_creation: SEO department has existing project 'Acme Corp SEO Campaign' with 3 tasks (Backlink Analysis - completed, Meta Tags Optimization - in_progress, Keyword Research - pending)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tasks Module fully tested. Hierarchical structure: Operations -> Departments (SEO, Meta, Social Media, Design, ERP) -> Projects -> Tasks. Each project can have documents. Tasks have timer tracking, priority (high/medium/low), status (pending/in_progress/completed/on_hold), assignment, due dates. Admins can create new departments. Fixed timezone-aware datetime bug in timer stop function at line 559 of department_routes.py.

departments_crud.details: GET returns 5 default departments (SEO, Meta, Social Media, Design, ERP). POST creates new department (admin only). DELETE soft-deletes department.

projects_crud.details: GET returns projects in department with task counts. POST creates project with name, client, description, dates, status, team. PUT updates project. DELETE soft-deletes project. Filter by status works.

tasks_crud.details: GET returns tasks with assignee names. POST creates task with name, priority, type, assignee, due date/time, status, work link. PUT updates task status/priority. DELETE removes task. Filter by status works.

documents_crud.details: GET returns project documents. POST adds document with name, link, doc_type. DELETE removes document. Documents appear in project detail.

timer_functionality.details: POST /timer/start starts timer and updates task status to in_progress. GET /timer returns running status. POST /timer/stop calculates duration and updates task time_spent. Fixed timezone bug.

frontend_departments_view.details: Departments displayed in grid with icons, colors, project counts. 'Add Department' button visible for admins.

frontend_projects_view.details: Projects displayed in grid/list view with search, status filter, view toggle. Shows task progress bar, document count, team count.

frontend_project_detail.details: Shows project info, documents section, task filters (All/Pending/In Progress/Completed/On Hold), task list with status toggle, edit/delete actions.

frontend_modals.details: Add Department, New Project, Add Task, Add Document modals all open and close correctly with proper form fields.

api_tests.GET /api/departments: PASS - Returns 5+ departments with project counts
api_tests.GET /api/departments/{dept_id}/projects: PASS - Returns projects with task/doc counts
api_tests.GET /api/departments/projects/{project_i: PASS - Returns project with tasks and documents

bug_fixed.issue: Timer stop function failed with 'TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'
bug_fixed.fix: Added timezone handling for start_time from MongoDB: if start_time.tzinfo is None: start_time = start_time.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
